items.text: Wend Debora
Chiengʼno Debora kod Barak wuod Abinoam nowero wendni:
"Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye
nikech jotelo mag Israel okawo loch,
kendo ji giwegi ochiwore mar luwogi!
"Winjuru, un ruodhi! Chikuru itu, un jotelo!
Abiro pako Jehova Nyasaye ka awerne;
anachuog ne Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wer.
"Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, piny noyiengni,
kendo polo nogingore,
mi koth ochwe kane iwuok Seir e piny Edom.
Got Sinai noyiengni
e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel.
"E ndalo mag Shamgar wuod Anath,
kendo e ndalo Jael,
yore nojwangʼ, mi jowuoth ne luwo yore matindo.
Teko mar jolweny e miech Israel norumo,
manyaka an Debora nabiro,
ma abedo ka min ji e piny Israel.
Kane giyiero nyiseche manyien,
lweny nochakore e dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ,
kata mana okumba kod tongʼ ne ok oyudie
kind jolwenj jo-Israel alufu piero angʼwen.
Opak Jehova Nyasaye
nikech chunya nigi jotend jo-Israel,
kaachiel gi jogo mochiwore!
"Un joma oidho punde marochere,
kobedo e matandiko molos gi ongede,
kendo un joma wuotho e wangʼ yo,
winjuru,
dwond joma wer koa kuonde mamon umboe pi;
ka giwero timbe makare mag Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo ka gipako timbe makare mag jolweny mage mager man Israel.
"Bangʼ mano oganda Jehova Nyasaye
nodhi e dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ.
Debora, chiew, chiew!
'Chungi kendo ia malo mondo ichak wer!
Aa malo, yaye Barak!
Ter jogo miseloyo e twech, yaye wuod Abinoam.'
"Eka jogo mane owe
nobiro ir ruodhi;
oganda Jehova Nyasaye
nobiro ira gi teko duto.
Jomoko kuomgi nowuok e gode mag Efraim,
ogandagi nodak Amalek,
kendo joma noa Benjamin noluwo bangʼu.
Jotend lweny noa Makir nobiro,
kendo joma noa Zebulun notingʼo ludh jatend lweny.
Jotend Isakar ne nigi Debora;
adier, Isakar ne nigi Barak,
koreto bangʼe ka gichiko holo.
To e gwenge mag Reuben
ne nitiere nono chuny matut.
En angʼo momiyo ne usiko
ka uoyo maj jokwath mondo omi uwinj ka jokwath liyo ni rombe?
To e gwenge mag Reuben
ne nitiere nono chuny matut.
Gilead nodongʼ loka Jordan.
To angʼo momiyo Dan nogalore but meli?
Asher to nodongʼ e dho nam
mi gidak e dho wedhe kuma yiedhi gowe.
Jo-Zebulun nochiwo ngimagi ne tho;
kamano bende Naftali noketo mare e kuonde kedo.
"Ruodhi mag Kanaan nobiro,
mokedo;
Tanak machiegni gi pige mag Megido,
to ne ok gidhi gi fedha,
kata kawo gimoro amora moyako.
Koa e polo, sulwe nokedo,
koa kama gichakore negikedo gi Sisera.
Aora Kishon noywoyogi,
aora ma hike ngʼeny, aora Kishon.
Dhi nyime, chunya; bed motegno!
Bangʼ mano mor mar tiende farese
nowinji kachikore gi teko mangʼeny.
Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni,
'Okwongʼ Meroz kaachiel gi joge gi kwongʼ malit,
nikech ne ok gibiro
mondo gikony Jehova Nyasaye e lwet joma tek.'
"Jael ma chi Heber ja-Keni en dhako
mogwedhi kuom mon duto,
kendo ogwedhe moloyo mon duto modak e hema.
Nokwayo pi modho, to nomiye chak;
nokelone chak mopwo e bakul moromo ruoth chiemoe.
Norieyo lwete mondo okaw sigingi mar hema,
ka lwete korachwich nokawogo twor.
Nogoyo Sisera, motoyo wiye,
kendo nopowo lela wangʼe.
Nopodho e tiende,
mogore piny; kendo kanyo ema nothoe.
Adier, nopodho e tiende, mogore piny;
kendo kama nopodhoeno, ema nogore piny motho.
"Min Sisera ne ngʼicho gie dirisa;
kaywak kama:
'Angʼo momiyo gache odeko kapok obiro?
Angʼo momiyo mor mar gechene ok winjre?'
Achiel kuom jotichne ma nyiri mariek nodwoke;
kawuoyo kende kama:
'Donge gipogo gik moyaki ka ngʼato
ka ngʼato yudo nyako achiel kata ariyo,
kendo imiyo Sisera lewni mabeyo kaachiel gi lewni mabeyo motwangʼ mongʼith,
monego arwaki?'
"Omiyo mad wasikgi duto rum, yaye Jehova Nyasaye!
To mad joma oheri chal gi chiengʼ,
mawuok gi teko."
Bangʼ mano piny Israel nobedo gi kwe kuom higni piero angʼwen.
